heading: INT. STARSHIP ARGENT DAWN - ENGINE CORE - SHIP NIGHT

units.text: INT. STARSHIP ARGENT DAWN - ENGINE CORE - SHIP NIGHT
A cathedral of glowing pipes and throbbing coils.
A yellow warning lamp spins.
COMMANDER HALLORAN, 50s, in a gold-trimmed uniform, grips a rail.
DR. XIMENA ROJAS-VANCE, 40s, a physicist with wild gray hair, taps a console.
BOSUN TUCK, 60s, a grizzled engineer in oil-stained overalls, hauls on a valve wheel.
Doctor, how long?
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: Eleven minutes before the core goes critical.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Eleven? I said nine.
units.name: TUCK

units.text: Your instruments are older than my daughter, Tuck.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: They've never lied to me.
units.name: TUCK

units.text: ENSIGN RAVI, 20s, in a crisp blue jumpsuit, bursts through the hatch, breathless.
Commander! The aft shields are failing!
units.name: RAVI

units.text: Ensign, take the other console.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: Sir, I haven't been trained --
units.name: RAVI

units.text: Neither was I, when I started.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: Ravi darts to the console.
Ximena and Tuck both reach for the same lever.
Their hands collide.
They glare at each other and then, as one, push.
The lamp flares white.
The pipes shudder.
Halloran braces, Ravi ducks, Tuck is thrown against the wall.
It's working!
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Don't say that. Saying it jinxes it.
units.name: TUCK

units.text: Bosun. Doctor. Ensign. If we get through this, I'm buying the first round.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: Sir, is that a promise?
units.name: RAVI

units.text: It's an order.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: The core's hum drops to a purr.
The warning lamp dims.
All four slump, grinning.
